video_title: DRAYMOND GREEN EST-IL ENCORE UN JOUEUR DE BASKET ?

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on the complexity of Draymond Green's Hall of Fame case
quotes.excerpt: I am very divided between the attack and the way of doing things of Eddie Johnson.
quotes.quote: I am very divided between the attack and the way of doing things of Eddie Johnson. Because what he says, he may not be wrong to say, have we ever seen a Hall of Famer enter like that? But do you say, it is incredible that this guy enters the Hall of Fame with everything he has done? And behind, the answer of Draymond Green who is still in the process of swelling his chest by saying, as if he still had things to prove. Whereas, you have nothing more to prove in fact. You have two titles of defensive player of the year, you have been part of a dynasty with a major role and you have four championship titles.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Moi je suis partagé. Je suis très partagé entre l'attaque et la manière de dire les choses d'Eddie Johnson. Parce que ce qu'il dit, il a peut-être pas tort de dire est-ce qu'on a déjà vu un joueur Hall of Fame rentrer comme ça? Mais du coup de dire, c'est incroyable en fait que ce mec-là rentre Hall of Fame avec tout ce qu'il a fait. Et la derrière, la réponse de Draymond Green qui est toujours en train de bomber le torse en disant, comme s'il avait encore des choses à prouver. Alors que, tu as plus rien à prouver en fait. Tu as deux titres de meilleur défenseur de l'année, tu as fait partie d'une dynastie avec un rôle majeur et tu as quatre titres de champion.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on the uncertainty of Draymond Green's future career path
quotes.excerpt: Draymond Green, I think that his career, the limit of his career between what he is, a future Hall of Famer
quotes.quote: Draymond Green, I think that his career, the limit of his career between what he is, a future Hall of Famer and potentially a guy who is a random who can potentially do three years in the NBA and finish in a dark Italian championship, it is not that fine. It is not that fine. And obviously, his career is linked to Stephen Curry, but the career of Stephen Curry is also linked to that of Draymond Green. I do not say that Stephen Curry would not have been Stephen Curry without Draymond Green, it is a certainty, there is one who pulled more one upwards, but there is one who managed to magnify one of the most beautiful players in history.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Draymond Green, je pense que sa carrière, la limite de sa carrière entre ce qu'il est, un futur Hall of Famer et potentiellement un mec qui est un random qui peut potentiellement faire trois ans en NBA et terminer dans un championnat italien sombre, elle est pas elle est pas si fine que ça. Elle est pas si fine que ça. Et évidemment que sa carrière elle est liée à Steph Curry, mais la carrière de Steph Curry est aussi liée à celle de Draymond Green. Je dis pas que Steph Curry n'aurait pas été Steph Curry sans Draymond Green, c'est une certitude, il y en a un qui a tiré plus un vers le haut, mais il y en a un qui a quand même réussi à magnifier l'un des plus beaux joueurs de l'histoire.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum compares Draymond Green to Dennis Rodman and Ben Wallace
quotes.excerpt: Are these Hall of Famers who, without their superstar, would not have led a team to scoring?
quotes.quote: Are these Hall of Famers who, without their superstar, would not have led a team to scoring, it is sure. Ben Wallace, he is not going to do it. Dennis Rodman, outside of the three, we do not remember what he did. We do not remember what he did in Chicago, we do not remember what he did in Cleveland, we do not remember what he did when he was in Orlando. I remember him in Chicago, it was catastrophic. It was catastrophic, but it was a guy who was in a system that was so extraordinary defensively.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Est-ce que ce sont des Hall of Famers qui, sans leur superstar, n'ont pas mené une équipe au scoring, c'est sûr. Ben Wallace, il va pas le faire. Dennis Rodman, hors des trois, on se rappelle pas de ce qu'il a fait. On se rappelle pas de ce qu'il a fait à Chicago, on se rappelle pas de ce qu'il a fait à Cleveland, on se rappelle pas de ce qu'il a fait quand il était à Orlando. Moi je m'en souviens à Chicago, c'était catastrophique. C'était catastrophique, mais c'était un mec qui était dans un système qui était tellement extraordinaire défensivement.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's impact in the final minutes
quotes.excerpt: I watched the Boston-Golden State match. You look at the two last minutes, it is him who wins the match.
quotes.quote: I watched the Boston-Golden State match. You look at the two last minutes, it is him who wins the match. He does not put a point. He does not put a three-point in the corner. No, it is not that. In the last two minutes, in fact what happens, there is one or two points of gap. There is an offensive rebound of Boston, he will look for the ball in the hand of Kevon Looney, he will provoke the foul, he will win a possession. And then behind, he will switch on Jayson Tatum, he will lock up Jayson Tatum, he will make him take the most difficult shot. These are only stupid things like that. And that, you realize that, and it was yesterday evening, so it was the result of his mess.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: J'ai regardé le match Boston-Golden State. Vous regardez les deux dernières minutes, c'est lui qui gagne le match. Il met pas un point. Il met pas un trois points dans le corner. Non, c'est pas ça. Dans les deux dernières minutes, en fait ce qui se passe, il y a un ou deux points d'écart. Il y a un rebond offensif de Boston, il va lui le prendre dans la main de Kevon Looney, il va provoquer la faute, il va gagner une possession. Et puis derrière, il va switcher sur Jayson Tatum, il va lock up Jayson Tatum, il va lui faire prendre le tir le plus difficile. Enfin c'est que des conneries comme ça. Et ça, tu te rends compte que, et c'était hier soir, donc c'était la suite de son embrouille.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's playmaking and impact in Tokyo
quotes.excerpt: In 2021 when we are in Tokyo, we return a bit, it is tight, but the guy who makes the plays
quotes.quote: In 2021 when we are in Tokyo, we return a bit, it is tight, but the guy who makes the plays to make win the match for Team USA, it is Draymond Green. Kevin Durant puts 30 and some points, but in the last two minutes, the one who makes us shit at the end, on a hit that makes us that gives a good offensive on a free throw, it is Draymond. These are only stupid things like that, that you will not see, that will not be flashy, you will not see highlights, you will not see replays. This is what I want to tell you, I am sure that no one remembers.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: En 2021 quand on est à Tokyo, on revient un peu, c'est serré, mais le mec qui fait les plays pour faire gagner le match pour Team USA, c'est Draymond Green. Kevin Durant met 30 et quelques points, mais dans les deux dernières minutes, celui qui nous fait chier à la fin, sur un il prend un qui nous fait qui donne un bon offensif sur un lancer franc, c'est Draymond. C'est que des conneries comme ça, que vous verrez pas, qui seront pas flashy, vous verrez pas de highlights, vous verrez pas de replay. Ça c'est ce que je veux te dire, je suis sûr que personne s'en rappelle.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on the ego of NBA players regarding criticism
quotes.excerpt: Sometimes we have a certain ego that we are not going to accept the criticism of people
quotes.quote: Sometimes we have a certain ego that we are not going to accept the criticism of people who have not done what we have done at the minimum. But that, but that is us. Me, there are things I have not accepted that someone tells me something, if you have not done at least what I have done.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Des fois on a un certain ego qu'on on va pas accepter les critiques des gens qu'ont pas fait ce qu'on a fait au minimum. Mais ça, mais ça c'est nous. Moi, moi il y a des trucs que j'ai pas accepté que quelqu'un me dise quelque chose, si t'as pas fait au moins ce que j'ai fait.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's credentials
quotes.excerpt: The guy has four rings, he is All-NBA, he is defensive player of the year, he has two gold medals.
quotes.quote: The guy has four rings, he is All-NBA, he is defensive player of the year, he has two gold medals. So, there are not many guys who can tell him something also.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Le mec il a quatre bagues, il est All-NBA, il est défenseur de l'année, il a deux médailles d'or olympique. Donc, il y a pas beaucoup de mecs qui peuvent lui dire quelque chose aussi.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's role as a connector for superstars
quotes.excerpt: It was the link of superstars because Steph, he runs, he gives the ball, he moves without the ball.
quotes.quote: It was the link of superstars because Steph, he runs, he gives the ball, he moves without the ball. Klay sets the pin-downs, and they are no longer there and nobody moves because no guy knows how to play like that. We return to last week, you have no NBA player who plays without the ball. So, Draymond Green finds himself with guys who do not know how to play, who know how to play only with the ball. He does what? He cannot move the ball, he cannot make the plays.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: C'était le lien de superstars parce que Steph, il court, il donne la balle, il bouge sans le ballon. Klay sort des pin-downs, et ils sont plus là et personne bouge parce qu'aucun mec ne sait jouer comme ça. On revient à la semaine dernière, tu as aucun joueur NBA qui sait jouer sans le ballon. Donc, Draymond Green se retrouve avec des mecs qui ne savent pas jouer, qui savent jouer qu'avec la balle. Il fait quoi? Il peut pas bouger la balle, il peut pas faire les plays.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's inability to adapt his game
quotes.excerpt: The problem is that he is born in a system and he does not know how to play
quotes.quote: The problem is that he is born in a system and he does not know how to play otherwise in fact. It has been 13, it has been 12-13 years that he plays in the same way. So you ask him to change today, it is impossible. It is literally impossible. He cannot.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Le problème c'est qu'il est né dans un système et il ne sait pas jouer autrement en fait. Ça fait 13, ça fait 12-13 ans qu'il joue de la même façon. Donc tu lui demandes de changer aujourd'hui, c'est impossible. C'est littéralement impossible. Il ne peut pas.

quotes.speaker: Nico Batum
quotes.summary_phrase: Nico Batum on Draymond Green's triple-double potential
quotes.excerpt: He can put triple-doubles in assists, steals, rebounds, without the points.
quotes.quote: He can put triple-doubles in assists, steals, rebounds, without the points.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Il peut mettre des triple-doubles en assists, steals, rebonds, sans les points.
